steps.title: Prepare Labware and Tips
steps.instruction: Set up the following labware and tips on the Opentrons platform:

substeps.instruction: VWR 96-Well Deep Well Plate (1000 μL) (Slot 7 on the Magnetic module)
Two Nest Well plate (100 μL) (Slots 2 and 3)
Two Nest 12 Well Reservoirs (15 mL) (Slots 1 and 4)

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Mince up to 10 mg of tissue and transfer to individual 1.5 mL tubes.

substeps.instruction: Use sterilized cutters to cut each 10 mg sample as small as possible

steps.title: Add Lysis Reagents
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffers and Proteinase K to each sample tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 μL TL Buffer to each sample
Add 20 μL Proteinase K Solution to each sample

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples at 55°C overnight in a shaking water bath.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Transfer Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples to remove debris and transfer the liquid phase.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (≥4,000 x g) for 5 minutes to pellet undigested tissue debris
Transfer 200 µL of the supernatant to the VWR 96-Well Deep Well Plate (1000 μL) without disturbing the undigested pellet
